outgoing.name: Fennel
outgoing.excerpt: Like its relatives anise, fennel, and caraway, it can also be used to flavour akvavit.

outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: Its leaves are sometimes used as a herb, with a rather strong taste reminiscent of anise; it is used mainly in Germany and Scandinavia.
